npcs.name: Old Warden
npcs.greeting: You made it through the pass. Good. The hollow is no place to linger.
lines: The imps come in threes — keep moving and they never surround you.
Ice slows them. Fire finishes them.
npcs.persona: A gruff old soldier who lost his company at the pass; kind underneath; speaks in short sentences.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.greeting: Coin for steel, steel for coin. Have a look.

intro.title: The Frozen Pass
intro.speaker: Old Warden
intro.text:
The pass has frozen over, and something stirs beneath the ice.

Hold the hollow until the storm breaks.

outro.title: The Storm Breaks
outro.speaker: Old Warden
outro.text: The last of them falls. Beyond the ridge, the road south lies open.
